tool.name: list_workspaces
tool.title: List Paseo workspaces
tool.description: List the workspaces Paseo knows across its hosts, most recently active first. Each row has the workspaceId (id) and host (serverId) that open_workspace and get_recent_messages take, plus name, project, branch, status, agent count, and last activity. This is the lookup step when the user names a workspace by what it is doing rather than by id: search with q, pick the row, then pass its id on. Answers from the catalog Paseo last published while it was open, so a workspace created since then is missing until Paseo is opened again. query is a case-insensitive substring match over the row.

q.description: Case-insensitive text matched against name, project, branch, status, and ids.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (Paseo defaults to 25).

tool.name: list_agents
tool.title: List Paseo agents
tool.description: List Paseo agent sessions, most recently active first. Each row has the agentId (id) and host (serverId) that open_agent, draft_agent_prompt, and send_agent_prompt take, plus workspaceId, name, provider, status, and last activity. Answers from the catalog Paseo last published while it was open. Filter by workspaceId, or with query as a case-insensitive substring match over the row.

q.description: Case-insensitive text matched against name, provider, status, and ids.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (Paseo defaults to 25).

tool.name: get_recent_messages
tool.title: Read recent agent messages
tool.description: Read the most recent messages of a Paseo agent, newest first, to report what it has been doing: what the user asked, what the agent answered, and which tools it ran. Pass exactly one of agentId or workspaceId; agentId wins if both are given, and neither means the read fails. With workspaceId the rows are merged across that workspace's active agents, so use agentId when the user cares about one session. To answer "what is the agent working on X doing", first call list_workspaces with q (or list_agents) to turn the description into an id, then call this with that id. Unlike list_workspaces and list_agents, these rows are fetched live from the Paseo daemon at query time, so the Paseo app process has to be running and its host reachable. When it is not, or the id is unknown, or the daemon times out, the read still succeeds and returns a single row with kind=notice whose text says what happened and what the user can do; report that, do not treat it as agent output. Each row has kind (user, assistant, tool, or notice), createdAt, agentId, agentName, and text clipped to 1000 characters. Longer messages and anything older than the returned window are not reachable here; use open_agent so the user can read the full session in Paseo.

agentId.description: Paseo agent session ID whose messages to read. Takes precedence over workspaceId.

workspaceId.description: Paseo workspace ID whose active agents' messages to merge. Give this or agentId, not neither.

limit.description: Maximum messages to return (Paseo defaults to 10).

tool.name: new_agent
tool.title: Start a new agent
tool.description: Open Paseo's New workspace screen with the prompt placed in the composer. The user chooses the project, model, and isolation in Paseo and taps Send; nothing is sent by this action. projectId and dir preselect a project or directory Paseo already knows. A successful EVA receipt proves only that Paseo opened.

serverId.description: Paseo host (daemon serverId). Omit to use the host of the last opened workspace, or the only configured host.

dir.description: Absolute directory on the host to preselect as the project root.

receipts.success: Paseo opened its New workspace screen with the prompt in the composer. The user has to choose a project and send it; EVA does not observe that.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://new links.

tool.name: open_agent
tool.title: Open an agent
tool.description: Open an existing Paseo agent session by ID so the user can read it. Requires the agent ID; the host is resolved by Paseo when omitted. A successful EVA receipt proves only the handoff to Paseo.

agentId.description: Paseo agent session ID on that host.

serverId.description: Paseo host (daemon serverId). Omit to use the host of the last opened workspace, or the only configured host.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the agent. Paseo shows an error itself if the agent or host is unknown.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://agent links.

tool.name: draft_agent_prompt
tool.title: Draft a follow-up for an agent
tool.description: Open a Paseo agent session with the prompt appended to its composer, unsent, so the user can review and tap Send. Use send_agent_prompt to deliver without a tap. A successful EVA receipt proves only that Paseo opened the agent.

agentId.description: Paseo agent session ID on that host.

serverId.description: Paseo host (daemon serverId). Omit to use the host of the last opened workspace, or the only configured host.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the agent with the prompt in its composer. The user has to send it; EVA does not observe that.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://agent links.

tool.name: send_agent_prompt
tool.title: Send a follow-up to an agent
tool.description: Open a Paseo agent session and ask Paseo to send the prompt to it immediately. Paseo only sends when its setting “Send prompts from links” is on; otherwise it places the prompt in the composer unsent and tells the user why. EVA cannot tell which happened: a successful receipt proves only the handoff, not delivery or completion of the agent's work.

agentId.description: Paseo agent session ID on that host.

serverId.description: Paseo host (daemon serverId). Omit to use the host of the last opened workspace, or the only configured host.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the agent and was asked to send the prompt. Delivery depends on Paseo's “Send prompts from links” setting and the host being online; EVA does not verify it.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://agent links.

tool.name: open_workspace
tool.title: Open a workspace
tool.description: Open a Paseo workspace by ID, optionally on a specific agent or terminal tab. A successful EVA receipt proves only the handoff to Paseo.

workspaceId.description: Paseo workspace ID on that host.

serverId.description: Paseo host (daemon serverId). Omit to use the host of the last opened workspace, or the only configured host.

agentId.description: Agent session tab to focus inside the workspace.

terminalId.description: Terminal tab to focus inside the workspace. Ignored when agentId is given.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the workspace. Paseo shows an error itself if the workspace or host is unknown.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://workspace links.

tool.name: open_history
tool.title: Open agent history
tool.description: Open Paseo's History screen listing recent agent sessions across hosts. Takes no arguments. A successful EVA receipt proves only the handoff to Paseo.

receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://sessions links.
